import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); r=tempfile.mkdtemp()
E={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(("GIT_","KB_"))}
E.update(GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull,GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1",GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t",GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t@example.com",GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t",GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t@example.com")
g=lambda *a: subprocess.run(["git",*a],cwd=d,env=E,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
g("init","-q","-b","main"); open(os.path.join(d,"notes.md"),"w").write("the runbook at kb/team-z/mdm/x.md\n"); g("add","-A"); g("commit","-qm","x"); tip=g("rev-parse","HEAD")
code="import sys;sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1]);import kbpublic;print(len(kbpublic.public_values(sys.argv[2],sys.argv[3])))"
run=lambda: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-c",code,os.path.abspath("_tools"),tip,d],env=dict(E,KB_ROOTS=r),capture_output=True,text=True)
a=run(); open(os.path.join(r,"_root.md"),"w").write("---\nroot: team-z\nid_prefix: TZ\nvisibility: internal\n---\n"); b=run()
print("before", a.stdout.strip(), a.stderr[-300:], "after", b.stdout.strip(), b.stderr[-300:])
sys.exit(0 if a.returncode==0 and b.returncode==0 and int(a.stdout)==0 and int(b.stdout)>0 else 1)
